evidence.statement: A composition-adjusted residual C2 score is frozen for all 1,000 primary tokens using only the 12 already-observed genomes.
The sparse primary 1,000-token occurrence corpus is insufficient to train a defensible repeated <=100-bp cross-genome X+Y conditional grammar model under the frozen support gate.
Panel 3 prospectively tests composition-adjusted C2 prediction, deep-lineage recurrence, and local-composition robustness.

unknowns: Whether literal-vs-masked transfer differs systematically by design distance.
Whether denser vocabulary enables conditional grammar recovery.
